'''Rod Latham Inserts in Space''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Rod Latham]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds13.htm Inserts in Space], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010319173001/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds13.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

* '''Player:''' [[Rod Latham]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
